summary: Become a Superhero in a Crime-Filled City!
description:
Rope Frog - Strange Vegas is a city simulator in third person view, where you drive an amazing cars or a motorbikes. You play is a hero / legend and whole city fears you. Become a chief on the streets of the town.

Are your ready for great anti criminal adventure? Stealing cars, racing through streets and shooting down gangsters. Do you have enough guts to rise to the top of the criminal piles? Try out all the supercars and bikes. Make stunts on a bmx or find an ultimate F-90, tank or devastating battle helicopter.

You have special powers. You can shoot dangerous laser beam from your eyes. You can shoot a rope to a building and climb over the building to the top. Don't mess with the police, they are the good ones. The style of city is similar to Miami or Las Vegas but actualy it's New York. Exciting adventure missions are waiting for you to get the necessary game resources that will be useful to you for more serious tasks. 

Explore the crime city, full of gangs and aggressive fractions. Become citizen's hope as a standard of justice, or come to the city as a new doom knight. You can also buy a lot of things in a shop to help you complete missions and release the city from all mafia sinners.At your disposal will be a rich arsenal of guns with which you will not get bored.Customize your character, making his image unique because this is your virtual warrior and he should look stylish.You can also work as a taxi driver or garbage man collector or fireman. The game has a large number of different vehicles.

Dominate the city with a devastating firepower of advanced military vehicles or upgrade your hero to knock down enemies in a few kicks! Let it be a beautiful city, do not turn into crime city with blood and robbery. The price of success in this gang world is very high, few can reach the top.
Try your skills in an exciting 3D third-person shooter with RPG elements. If you are ready to test yourself - then go ahead, show everyone who is a real gangster in the town, eliminate all fake competitors. In the store, you will find hats, masks, glasses,and much more. There are about 200 cars for use. 

Farming
If you want to earn extra money, you can become a farmer. You need to cultivate your field and grow crops such as grain etc. Or you convert your field into enclosure and keep there life stock such as cow, pigs, chicken, sheep, goats.

Mining
You can hire people that will mine minirals in a local mine. Each ore will give you different amount of money. You need to expand your tunnels to find more ore deposites. You can level up your miners and deposites so they will earn you money faster.

Air tracks
You can challange your self in tracks that are in the air. You need to pick a car and drive from start to the end in shortest time.

Lockpicking
You can find many different houses that you can rob.

Fighting pits
You can fight in a tourmanet where you have to beat up several opponents to win a money.

Weapons
This game contains about 60 different weapons that you can use to kill your enemies

Investing
You can buy different shops in the city that can generate you a pasive income. You can buy ads to boost your income. You can also hack a ATM and try to rob it.

Dance Club
You can dance in a local dance club and earn money from it. You can pick from a list of songs

Hair Dresser
You can work as a hair dresser and earn money. Women will come to you and order a new hair cut.

Mechs and Morphlings
You can buy several different robots that wreck the streets of a local city.

Super Powers and abilities
You hero has a list of different super powers. For example laser eyes, frost bomb, tornado, black hole, reality rift, worm hole etc and you can also pick from a list of passive abilities for example bullet ressistance, cheaper buy orders, higher income from a job

Own house
You can buy a house and then make your home in it. You can also buy furniture and other equipment and then you can store your cars in a garage close by the house.
